findings.action: R2 applies only when the plan asks for structural mappings, but this condition checks only for material structural facts. Review-plan resolution observes structure before selecting overlays, so a nonmatching structural selector can leave material facts without a required mapping criterion. Such scopes are now refused for unbased decisions although reviewStructuralCausalityBlockers returns immediately without mapping owners. Gate readiness on a required RequiresStructuralMapping criterion. TestSealReadinessRefusesADecisionWithoutBasis demonstrates the overreach by expecting blockers from a bundle with no criteria.

R3 requires draft-check <run|bundle>, but every positional argument is passed as a bundle ID to LoadReviewBundle, which accepts only rvb-* IDs. Run IDs therefore always fail before draft validation and cannot select their recorded bundle and round. Resolve run references explicitly and test that invocation. The source-built binary reproduced the bundle-ID rejection for draft-check run-fixture --draft -.
